question: The term towards faster and more inclusive growth was coined in which Five year plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11th**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"towards faster and more inclusive growth"** was coined in the **11th Five Year Plan**, which was implemented from **2007-2012.**
 
• The main objective of the 11th Five Year Plan was to achieve a **GDP growth rate of 9% per annum**, while ensuring that the benefits of growth were shared by all sections of society.
 
• The plan focused on several key areas such as **infrastructure development, education, healthcare, **and** rural development **to achieve inclusive growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **10th Five Year Plan**, which was implemented from** 2002-2007**, aimed to achieve a GDP growth rate of** 8%**, while the **9th Five Year Plan (1997-2002)** aimed for a growth rate of **6%.**
 
• **The 8th Five Year Plan (1992-1997) **focused on modernizing the Indian economy and reducing poverty through increased investment in agriculture, rural development, and infrastructure.
